name: Copperveil Chromeskin Club Strike Set
description: A Tier 2 circuit-worker's Saturday night transformation — designed explicitly to put chrome augmentation on display in a way the factory floor never allows. The centerpiece is a structured synth-leather vest in deep copper-brown with chrome-plated shoulder rivets and open arm channels: both sleeves are absent entirely, replaced by fitted chrome-display bracers that run from wrist to mid-bicep, leaving the full augmented arm — or a natural arm — exposed and framed. The back panel of the vest is cut in a deep V to expose spinal rig ports and upper chrome plating for those with dorsal augmentation. The bottoms are slim-cut trousers in matte gunmetal synth-leather with narrow amber bioluminescent piping running down the outer seams, pulsing slowly at rest and quickening in response to bass frequencies via a sewn-in vibration sensor strip. A wide chrome-buckle belt with three adjustable positioning rings anchors the waist. Footwear is ankle-high boots in matching gunmetal synth-leather with copper-tipped toes and magnetic closures. A single long earring of linked copper wire and a micro-holoprojector pendant — cycling through slow amber geometric loops — complete the look. The overall silhouette is sharp and deliberate: this person clocked out two hours ago and is not the same person who clocked in.
functionality: Open arm channels designed for full chrome arm display or standard arms. Deep V-back accommodates spinal rigs and dorsal chrome plating. Vibration sensor strip in trouser seam syncs bioluminescent piping to ambient bass. Belt positioning rings allow attachment of small carry pouches. Magnetic boot closures are fast-release for quick removal.
what_it_says: You work the floor, you have the chrome to prove it, and on your nights off you wear that chrome like jewelry instead of hiding it under a uniform. You earned your augments and you're not ashamed of a single seam.
worn_by: Tier 2 factory workers and transit operators with chrome augmentation
weekend nightlife crowd who dress up without dressing out of their tier
manufacturer: Copperveil — Circuit district street label, two-person operation out of a converted freight container
story_hooks: The micro-holoprojector pendant was recently purchased secondhand and still contains someone else's personal holographic files — including what appears to be a recording of a private Tier 4 meeting the previous owner should not have attended.

A Copperveil vest is found at a crime scene, and the chrome-display bracers have biometric trace data embedded in their interior lining — standard for aug hardware, but this data points to someone who died six months ago.

A Tier 4 corponation fashion division has begun quietly buying up Copperveil pieces to reverse-engineer the vibration-sync bioluminescent piping, and the two-person label's founders have just noticed their designs appearing in Tier 4 club previews with no credit.

physical_description.visual_profile: A striking statement outfit designed to celebrate augmented bodies in their off-hours glory. Sharp, geometric silhouette with intentional exposure of arm augmentations and spinal modifications. Copper and gunmetal palette creates a luminous, industrial aesthetic. The wearer reads as confident, modded, and deliberately transitioning from function to nightlife.
physical_description.fit: Structured and tailored through the torso with the vest sitting crisp and angular; slim through the hip and thigh with the trousers; snug at wrists and ankles. The absence of sleeves creates a deliberately exposed, almost architectural frame around the arms.
physical_description.primary_material: Synth-leather (copper-brown vest, gunmetal trousers and boots); chrome plating (shoulder rivets, bracers, belt buckle, toe caps); copper wire and micro-electronics (earring and pendant)
physical_description.texture: The synth-leather has a smooth, treated finish with subtle sheen; chrome elements are polished and reflective; bioluminescent piping creates a soft glow; copper accents oxidize subtly over time. The overall feel is simultaneously sleek and tactile.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep copper-brown vest anchoring warm tones; matte gunmetal synth-leather base; chrome and polished metal accents in silver-white; amber bioluminescent piping as the key reactive accent; hints of oxidized copper for patina
physical_description.closures: Chrome-buckle belt with three adjustable positioning rings at the waist; magnetic closures on the ankle boots; the bracers appear friction-fit and form-locked to the arms; the vest likely uses hidden magnetic snaps or a friction-lock system down the front
distinctive_features: Completely sleeveless design with open arm channels — a deliberate augmentation display frame
Deep V-cut back panel explicitly designed to expose spinal rig ports and dorsal chrome plating
Chrome-plated shoulder rivets with architectural precision
Fitted chrome-display bracers (wrist to mid-bicep) framing the augmented arms
Amber bioluminescent piping down outer trouser seams with embedded vibration sensor — responds to bass frequencies
Wide chrome-buckle belt with three adjustable positioning rings for modular fit adjustment
Magnetic closures on ankle boots with copper-tipped toe caps
Single linked copper-wire earring suggesting DIY modding culture
Micro-holoprojector pendant cycling through amber geometric loops — a personal light show accessory
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2 — expensive enough to signal disposable income and corpo proximity, but deliberately street-made and anti-establishment in messaging. The craftsmanship and materials cost suggest a worker who spends well to stand out.
physical_description.cultural_context: Circuit district street culture; afterhours liberation from factory-floor anonymity; augmentation pride; deliberate rejection of corpo dress codes; weekend warrior aesthetic. Wearing this announces: 'I am modded, I am proud, and I am not clocking back in until Monday.'
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to very lightly worn when new; develops a beautiful patina over weeks with subtle oxidation on copper elements and micro-scratches on chrome. The bioluminescent piping may show faint dimming over months of use. Well-maintained by owners who treat it as investment wear.
